package examplerelation

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

const (
	relationTestSourceID = "40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
	relationTestTargetID = "40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
	relationTestID       = "40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
)

type relationExampleRepositoryStub struct {
	examples map[string]domain.LessonExample
}

func (*relationExampleRepositoryStub) ReplaceByLesson(context.Context, string, []domain.LessonExample) error {
	return nil
}
func (r *relationExampleRepositoryStub) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.LessonExample, error) {
	example, ok := r.examples[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &example, nil
}
func (*relationExampleRepositoryStub) ListByLesson(context.Context, string, bool) ([]domain.LessonExample, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (*relationExampleRepositoryStub) Delete(context.Context, string) error { return nil }

type relationRepositoryStub struct {
	replaced   []domain.LessonExampleRelation
	listed     []domain.LessonExampleRelation
	activeOnly bool
}

func (r *relationRepositoryStub) ReplaceBySourceExample(_ context.Context, _ string, relations []domain.LessonExampleRelation) error {
	r.replaced = relations
	return nil
}
func (r *relationRepositoryStub) ListBySourceExample(_ context.Context, _ string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, error) {
	r.activeOnly = activeOnly
	return r.listed, nil
}
func (*relationRepositoryStub) Delete(context.Context, string) error { return nil }

func validExampleRelation() domain.LessonExampleRelation {
	return domain.LessonExampleRelation{
		ID:              relationTestID,
		SourceKey:       "example-relation.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
		TargetExampleID: relationTestTargetID,
		Relation:        domain.LessonRelationImplementation,
		PrimaryStack:    "javascript",
		Stacks:          []string{"javascript"},
		Concepts:        []string{"sequence"},
	}
}

func TestReplaceExampleRelationsPersistsSupportedKinds(t *testing.T) {
	examples := &relationExampleRepositoryStub{examples: map[string]domain.LessonExample{
		relationTestSourceID: {ID: relationTestSourceID, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusActive},
		relationTestTargetID: {ID: relationTestTargetID, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusActive},
	}}
	for kind := range supportedRelations {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			relation := validExampleRelation()
			relation.Relation = kind
			relations := &relationRepositoryStub{}
			err := (ReplaceExampleRelations{Examples: examples, Relations: relations}).Handle(
				context.Background(),
				relationTestSourceID,
				[]domain.LessonExampleRelation{relation},
			)
			if err != nil || len(relations.replaced) != 1 || relations.replaced[0].Relation != kind {
				t.Fatalf("kind %q failed: relations=%#v err=%v", kind, relations.replaced, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReplaceExampleRelationsRejectsInvalidAndDanglingEdges(t *testing.T) {
	examples := &relationExampleRepositoryStub{examples: map[string]domain.LessonExample{
		relationTestSourceID: {ID: relationTestSourceID},
		relationTestTargetID: {ID: relationTestTargetID},
	}}
	self := validExampleRelation()
	self.TargetExampleID = relationTestSourceID
	missingPrimary := validExampleRelation()
	missingPrimary.PrimaryStack = ""
	primaryMismatch := validExampleRelation()
	primaryMismatch.Stacks = []string{"go"}

	for name, relation := range map[string]domain.LessonExampleRelation{
		"self":             self,
		"missing primary":  missingPrimary,
		"primary mismatch": primaryMismatch,
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			err := (ReplaceExampleRelations{Examples: examples, Relations: &relationRepositoryStub{}}).Handle(
				context.Background(), relationTestSourceID, []domain.LessonExampleRelation{relation},
			)
			if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}

	dangling := validExampleRelation()
	dangling.TargetExampleID = "40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099"
	err := (ReplaceExampleRelations{Examples: examples, Relations: &relationRepositoryStub{}}).Handle(
		context.Background(), relationTestSourceID, []domain.LessonExampleRelation{dangling},
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("expected dangling target to fail, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestListExampleRelationsHidesInactivePublicSource(t *testing.T) {
	examples := &relationExampleRepositoryStub{examples: map[string]domain.LessonExample{
		relationTestSourceID: {ID: relationTestSourceID, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusInactive},
	}}
	_, err := (ListExampleRelations{Examples: examples, Relations: &relationRepositoryStub{}}).Handle(
		context.Background(), relationTestSourceID, true,
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("inactive source must be hidden, got %v", err)
	}
}
